description: This file defines classes and functions related to configuring FCoE (Fibre Channel over Ethernet) network interfaces for different Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) versions, including data classes and command classes for kickstart automation.

classes.name: F12_FcoeData
classes.description: Data class for FCoE configuration in F12 version.

classes.name: F13_FcoeData
classes.description: Data class for FCoE configuration in F13 version, extending F12_FcoeData.

classes.name: RHEL7_FcoeData
classes.description: Data class for RHEL7-specific FCoE configuration, extending F13_FcoeData.

classes.name: F28_FcoeData
classes.description: Data class for F28 version, extending F13_FcoeData.

classes.name: RHEL8_FcoeData
classes.description: RHEL8-specific FCoE data class, extending F28_FcoeData.

classes.name: RHEL9_FcoeData
classes.description: RHEL9-specific FCoE data class, extending F28_FcoeData.

classes.name: RHEL10_FcoeData
classes.description: RHEL10-specific FCoE data class, extending F28_FcoeData.

classes.name: F12_Fcoe
classes.description: Command class for F12 version, handling FCoE network interface configuration.

classes.name: F13_Fcoe
classes.description: Extended command class for F13 version, adding DCB option.

classes.name: RHEL7_Fcoe
classes.description: RHEL7-specific FCoE command class, adding autovlan option.

classes.name: F28_Fcoe
classes.description: F28 version command class, adding autovlan option.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes data classes and command classes with version-specific attributes.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates string representation of command-line arguments based on class attributes.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the data object.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the command, adding version-specific options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and creates a data object, warning on duplicates.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of FCoE configurations.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for data objects.
